facts.business: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of sugar, industrial alcohol/ethanol, and power generation from bagasse across its 14 sugar plants, 6 distilleries, and 14 co-generation plants in Uttar Pradesh, India.
key_risks: Raw material risk due to cane variety issues affecting yield and sugar recovery in Uttar Pradesh over the last 2-3 years
Sugar price risk due to mismatch between state-fixed cane prices and market-driven sugar realisations; Minimum Selling Price (MSP) of sugar fixed at ₹31/kg since Feb 2019 with no increase since
Regulatory risk from disjointed sugarcane pricing by state government and evolving government policies
Ability to make timely cane price payments to farmers affecting cane availability
facts.related_party_note: The Company has transactions with related parties including Bajaj Power Ventures Private Limited, Lalitpur Power Generation Company Limited, Phenil Sugars Limited, Bajaj Aviation Private Limited, and Bajaj Power Generation Private Limited. Investments in LPGCL are pledged against loans taken by the Company and LPGCL. During the year, the Company tendered 67,19,573 equity shares of LPGCL in a buyback at ₹938.75 per share, receiving ₹630.80 crore, and sold 275,000 equity shares for ₹28.11 crore. Promoter loans and YTM/RoR obligations were settled/converted during the year.
